# foreman_katello_repository (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_katello_repository" "debian_12_base" {
  name = "debian12base"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the katello repository to look up.

### Read-Only

- `checksum_type` (String) Checksum type
- `content_type` (String) Content type of the repository
- `description` (String) Description of the repository
- `download_concurrency` (Number) Download concurrency
- `download_policy` (String) Download policy
- `gpg_key_id` (Number) GPG key ID
- `http_proxy_id` (Number) HTTP proxy ID
- `http_proxy_policy` (String) HTTP proxy policy
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) Label of the repository
- `mirror_on_sync` (Boolean) Mirror on sync
- `mirroring_policy` (String) Mirroring policy
- `product_id` (Number) Product ID
- `unprotected` (Boolean) Whether the repository is unprotected
- `url` (String) URL of the repository
